spans.text: Add ${NAME:+word} interpolation to python-dotenv: substitute word only when NAME resolves to a nonempty string; otherwise substitute an empty string. Apply this through dotenv_values and load_dotenv, preserving override precedence between earlier file values and the process environment. Keep the existing flat expression grammar: word ends at the first closing brace and is not recursively interpolated; do not add nested expansion or shell evaluation. Preserve existing ${NAME}, ${NAME:-default}, bare variables, adjacent substitutions, interpolate=False, unassigned keys and malformed-expression behavior. Do not change unrelated parsing or environment behavior.

import io, json, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/src')
from dotenv import dotenv_values, load_dotenv
case = json.load(sys.stdin)
os.environ.clear()
if case == 'alternate':
    for value, expected in [('present', 'chosen'), ('', ''), (None, '')]:
        if value is not None: os.environ['BASE'] = value
        else: os.environ.pop('BASE', None)
        got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('OUT=before${BASE:+chosen}after\n'))
        assert got['OUT'] == 'before' + expected + 'after', got
elif case == 'precedence':
    for override, external, local, expected in [(False, '', 'file', ''), (True, '', 'file', 'chosen'),
                                               (False, 'env', '', 'chosen'), (True, 'env', '', '')]:
        os.environ.clear(); os.environ['BASE'] = external
        load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO('BASE=' + local + '\nOUT=${BASE:+chosen}\n'), override=override)
        assert os.environ['OUT'] == expected, dict(os.environ)
elif case == 'legacy':
    os.environ['BASE'] = ''
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('A=${BASE:-fallback}\nB=${MISSING:-fallback}\nC=${BASE}\nD=$BASE\nE\n'))
    assert got == dict(A='', B='fallback', C='', D='$BASE', E=None), got
elif case == 'literal':
    os.environ.update(BASE='yes', OTHER='expanded')
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('A=${BASE:+$OTHER}\nB=${BASE:+}\nC=x${BASE:+α}${BASE:+β}y\nD=${BASE:+unfinished\n'))
    assert got == dict(A='$OTHER', B='', C='xαβy', D='${BASE:+unfinished'), got
elif case == 'disabled-and-unassigned':
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('BASE\nA=${BASE:+chosen}\nB=${ABSENT:+chosen}\n'))
    assert got == dict(BASE=None, A='', B=''), got
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('A=${BASE:+chosen}\n'), interpolate=False)
    assert got['A'] == '${BASE:+chosen}', got
elif case == 'ordinary-values':
    os.environ['BASE'] = 'process'
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('A=${BASE}\nB=x${BASE}${BASE}y\n'))
    assert got == dict(A='process', B='xprocessprocessy'), got
elif case == 'values-precedence':
    for external, local, expected in [('', 'file', 'chosen'), ('env', '', '')]:
        os.environ.clear(); os.environ['BASE'] = external
        got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('BASE=' + local + '\nOUT=${BASE:+chosen}\n'))
        assert got['OUT'] == expected, got
elif case == 'flat-braces':
    for base, expected in [('yes', '${OTHER}'), ('', '}'), (None, '}')]:
        os.environ.clear()
        os.environ['OTHER'] = 'expanded'
        if base is not None:
            os.environ['BASE'] = base
        text = 'OUT=prefix${BASE:+${OTHER}}suffix\n'
        got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO(text))
        assert got['OUT'] == 'prefix' + expected + 'suffix', got
        load_dotenv(stream=io.StringIO(text))
        assert os.environ['OUT'] == 'prefix' + expected + 'suffix', dict(os.environ)
    os.environ.update(BASE='yes')
    got = dotenv_values(stream=io.StringIO('OUT=${BASE:+${ABSENT:-fallback}}${BASE:+tail}\n'))
    assert got['OUT'] == '${ABSENT:-fallback}tail', got
else: raise AssertionError(case)
print('ok')

spans.text: Fix SpecifierSet.filter so its automatic prerelease policy considers the complete intersection: when no matching final or post release exists, return matching prereleases; an out-of-range final must not suppress them. When a matching final exists, suppress prereleases unless explicitly enabled. Preserve explicit True/False policies at both constructor and call levels, prerelease bounds, exclusions, empty sets, Version objects, original item identity, input order and duplicates. Accept one-shot iterables without restarting them. Preserve existing contains and individual Specifier comparison behavior.

import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/src')
from packaging.specifiers import SpecifierSet
from packaging.version import Version
case = json.load(sys.stdin)
def check(spec, values, expected, constructor=None, call=None):
    original = list(values)
    seen = []
    def once():
        for item in original:
            seen.append(item)
            yield item
    result = list(SpecifierSet(spec, prereleases=constructor).filter(once(), prereleases=call))
    assert [str(v) for v in result] == expected, result
    assert seen == original and all(any(v is item for item in original) for v in result)
if case == 'fallback':
    check('>=1,<2', ['0.9', '1.5a1', '2.1'], ['1.5a1'])
    check('<2,>=1', ['1.6rc1', '1.5a1', '1.6rc1'], ['1.6rc1', '1.5a1', '1.6rc1'])
elif case == 'matching-finals':
    check('>=1,<2', ['1.5a1', '1.4', '2.1', '1.6rc1', '1.4'], ['1.4', '1.4'])
    check('>=1,<2', ['1.5a1', '1.4.post1'], ['1.4.post1'])
elif case == 'explicit':
    for kwargs in [dict(constructor=False), dict(call=False), dict(constructor=True, call=False)]:
        check('>=1,<2', ['1.5a1'], [], **kwargs)
    for kwargs in [dict(constructor=True), dict(call=True), dict(constructor=False, call=True)]:
        check('>=1,<2', ['1.5a1', '1.4'], ['1.5a1', '1.4'], **kwargs)
elif case == 'bounds-and-exclusions':
    check('>=1.5a1,<2', ['1.5a1', '1.6'], ['1.5a1', '1.6'])
    check('>=1,<2,!=1.5a1', ['1.5a1', '1.6rc1', '3'], ['1.6rc1'])
    check('>1.0,<2', ['1.0.post1', '1.1a1'], ['1.1a1'])
elif case == 'empty-and-objects':
    check('', ['1.2a1', '1.1'], ['1.1'])
    check('', ['1.2a1'], ['1.2a1'])
    check('', ['1.2a1'], [], call=False)
    values = [Version('1.5a1'), Version('1.6rc1')]
    result = list(SpecifierSet('>=1,<2').filter(iter(values)))
    assert len(result) == 2 and all(a is b for a, b in zip(values, result))
    assert list(SpecifierSet('>=1,<2').filter(iter([]))) == []
elif case == 'contains-policy':
    selector = SpecifierSet('>=1,<2')
    assert selector.contains('1.4')
    assert not selector.contains('0.9') and not selector.contains('2.1')
    assert not selector.contains('1.5a1')
    assert selector.contains('1.5a1', prereleases=True)
    assert not selector.contains('1.5a1', prereleases=False)
elif case == 'individual-filter':
    from packaging.specifiers import Specifier
    values = [Version('0.9'), Version('1.1'), '2.0']
    result = list(Specifier('>=1').filter(iter(values)))
    assert len(result) == 2 and result[0] is values[1] and result[1] is values[2], result
else: raise AssertionError(case)
print('ok')

spans.text: On Unix, ignore relative XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME values and use their existing defaults. For XDG_DATA_DIRS and XDG_CONFIG_DIRS, discard empty and relative entries individually; if no absolute entries remain, use the existing defaults. Preserve absolute paths verbatim, including spaces, input order and duplicates. Keep app/version suffixes, multipath selection, Path wrappers, directory iterators and ensure_exists consistent. Never create a directory from a rejected relative value. Do not change runtime, media or non-Unix directory behavior.

import json, os, sys, types
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/src')
sys.modules['platformdirs.version'] = types.SimpleNamespace(__version__='4.3.6', __version_tuple__=(4, 3, 6))

from pathlib import Path
from platformdirs import user_config_dir, site_config_dir, user_config_path
from platformdirs.unix import Unix
case = json.load(sys.stdin)
os.environ.clear()
os.environ['HOME'] = '/tmp/fixture-home'
if case == 'user-homes':
    for kind, fallback in [('data', '.local/share'), ('config', '.config'), ('cache', '.cache'), ('state', '.local/state')]:
        key = 'XDG_' + kind.upper() + '_HOME'
        for value in ['', 'relative', '  relative', './nested']:
            os.environ[key] = value
            assert getattr(Unix('demo', version='2'), 'user_' + kind + '_dir') == '/tmp/fixture-home/' + fallback + '/demo/2'
        os.environ[key] = '/tmp/absolute space'
        assert getattr(Unix('demo', version='2'), 'user_' + kind + '_dir') == '/tmp/absolute space/demo/2'
elif case == 'site-mixed':
    for kind in ['data', 'config']:
        os.environ['XDG_' + kind.upper() + '_DIRS'] = 'relative:/tmp/one::/tmp/two:/tmp/one'
        instance = Unix('demo', version='2', multipath=True)
        value = getattr(instance, 'site_' + kind + '_dir')
        assert value == '/tmp/one/demo/2:/tmp/two/demo/2:/tmp/one/demo/2', value
        assert getattr(instance, 'site_' + kind + '_path') == Path('/tmp/one/demo/2')
        assert getattr(Unix('demo', version='2'), 'site_' + kind + '_dir') == '/tmp/one/demo/2'
elif case == 'site-defaults':
    for value in ['', ':relative::', 'relative:also-relative']:
        os.environ['XDG_DATA_DIRS'] = value; os.environ['XDG_CONFIG_DIRS'] = value
        instance = Unix('demo', version='2', multipath=True)
        assert instance.site_data_dir == '/usr/local/share/demo/2:/usr/share/demo/2'
        assert instance.site_config_dir == '/etc/xdg/demo/2'
elif case == 'wrappers-and-iterators':
    os.environ.update(XDG_CONFIG_HOME='relative', XDG_CONFIG_DIRS='bad:/tmp/valid')
    assert user_config_dir('demo', version='2') == '/tmp/fixture-home/.config/demo/2'
    assert user_config_path('demo', version='2') == Path('/tmp/fixture-home/.config/demo/2')
    assert site_config_dir('demo', version='2', multipath=True) == '/tmp/valid/demo/2'
    assert list(Unix('demo', version='2').iter_config_dirs()) == ['/tmp/fixture-home/.config/demo/2', '/tmp/valid/demo/2']
elif case == 'creation-and-spaces':
    os.chdir('/tmp')
    os.environ['XDG_CONFIG_HOME'] = 'rejected-relative'
    instance = Unix('demo', version='2', ensure_exists=True)
    assert Path(instance.user_config_dir).is_dir()
    assert not Path('/tmp/rejected-relative').exists()
    os.environ['XDG_CONFIG_DIRS'] = '/tmp/space name :/tmp/other'
    assert Unix(multipath=True).site_config_dir == '/tmp/space name :/tmp/other'
elif case == 'absolute-compatibility':
    os.environ.update(XDG_DATA_HOME='/tmp/data', XDG_CONFIG_HOME='/tmp/config', XDG_CACHE_HOME='/tmp/cache',
                      XDG_STATE_HOME='/tmp/state', XDG_DATA_DIRS='/tmp/site1:/tmp/site2', XDG_CONFIG_DIRS='/tmp/configs')
    instance = Unix('demo', version='2', multipath=True)
    assert instance.user_data_dir == '/tmp/data/demo/2'
    assert instance.user_cache_dir == '/tmp/cache/demo/2'
    assert instance.user_log_dir == '/tmp/state/demo/2/log'
    assert list(instance.iter_data_dirs()) == ['/tmp/data/demo/2', '/tmp/site1/demo/2', '/tmp/site2/demo/2']
    assert instance.site_config_dir == '/tmp/configs/demo/2'
elif case == 'site-creation':
    os.chdir('/tmp')
    for kind in ['data', 'config']:
        rejected = 'discarded-' + kind
        allowed = '/tmp/allowed-' + kind
        os.environ['XDG_' + kind.upper() + '_DIRS'] = rejected + ':' + allowed
        instance = Unix('demo', version='2', multipath=True, ensure_exists=True)
        got = getattr(instance, 'site_' + kind + '_dir')
        assert got == allowed + '/demo/2', got
        assert Path(got).is_dir()
        assert not Path('/tmp/' + rejected).exists()
elif case == 'unrelated-directories':
    for value in ['/tmp/runtime-root', 'relative-runtime']:
        os.environ['XDG_RUNTIME_DIR'] = value
        instance = Unix('demo', version='2')
        assert instance.user_runtime_dir == value + '/demo/2'
        assert instance.site_runtime_dir == value + '/demo/2'
    os.environ['XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR'] = 'relative-documents'
    assert Unix().user_documents_dir == 'relative-documents'
else: raise AssertionError(case)
print('ok')
